items.title: From neural development to regenerative medicine: A research journey in stem cell biology, spinal cord repair, and iPSC-based drug discovery.
items.summary: This commemorative article reflects on a research journey spanning neural development, stem cell biology, regenerative medicine, and iPSC-based drug discovery. My early work focused on RNA-mediated regulation in the nervous system, including studies on myelin basic protein gene regulation and the identification and functional characterization of the RNA-binding protein Musashi. These studies contributed to the conceptual foundation of neural stem cell biology and helped establish methods for identifying and isolating neural stem/progenitor cells, including those present in the adult human brain. Building on this foundation, my colleagues and I pursued translational research in spinal cord injury, ranging from analyses of injury pathophysiology and molecular interventions to preclinical studies using rodent and non-human primate models. These efforts ultimately led to the first-in-human clinical study of induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neural stem/progenitor cell transplantation for subacute spinal cord injury. In parallel, we developed patient-derived iPSC platforms for neurological disease modeling and drug discovery, particularly for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, where iPSC-based screening identified Ropinirole as a therapeutic candidate and enabled reverse translational research linking cellular phenotypes with clinical responses. Looking ahead, I argue that the future of regenerative therapy will depend on the continued integration of developmental biology, stem cell science, disease modeling, rehabilitation, and clinical translation to address unmet medical needs in disorders of the central nervous system.
items.titleZh: 从神经发育到再生医学：干细胞生物学、脊髓修复和基于iPSC的药物发现研究之旅
items.summaryZh: 本文是作者研究生涯的回顾，总结了从神经发育基础研究到再生医学转化的历程。关键内容包括：发现RNA结合蛋白Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能；建立神经干/祖细胞分离方法；开展脊髓损伤的临床前研究并推进至首次人体试验；利用患者iPSC平台筛选出ALS候选药物罗匹尼罗。文章强调未来再生治疗需要多学科整合。
items.insight: 这篇文章由该领域资深研究者撰写，系统梳理了从基础神经发育研究到iPSC临床转化的完整路径，特别是罗匹尼罗作为ALS候选药物的发现过程，为ALS研究者提供了药物筛选和反向转化研究的范例，值得关注其方法学启示。

aiRead.keyFinding: 作者回顾了其研究历程，重点包括Musashi在神经干细胞中的功能、脊髓损伤的iPSC移植临床试验，以及利用iPSC筛选出ALS候选药物罗匹尼罗。
aiRead.limitation: 作为个人回顾性文章，内容基于作者自身经验，可能缺乏系统性综述的全面性，且未提供原始数据。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注罗匹尼罗治疗ALS的后续临床试验结果，以及iPSC技术在神经退行性疾病药物发现中的进一步应用。

items.abstractZh: 这篇纪念性文章回顾了涵盖神经发育、干细胞生物学、再生医学和基于iPSC的药物发现的研究历程。早期工作聚焦于神经系统中的RNA介导调控，包括髓鞘碱性蛋白基因调控研究，以及RNA结合蛋白Musashi的鉴定和功能表征。这些研究为神经干细胞生物学的概念基础做出了贡献，并帮助建立了识别和分离神经干/祖细胞（包括成人脑中的神经干/祖细胞）的方法。在此基础上，作者及其同事开展了脊髓损伤的转化研究，从损伤病理生理学分析和分子干预，到使用啮齿动物和非人灵长类模型的临床前研究。这些努力最终促成了诱导多能干细胞来源的神经干/祖细胞移植治疗亚急性脊髓损伤的首次人体临床研究。与此同时，他们开发了患者来源的iPSC平台用于神经系统疾病建模和药物发现，特别是在肌萎缩侧索硬化症中，基于iPSC的筛选确定了罗匹尼罗作为治疗候选药物，并实现了将细胞表型与临床反应联系起来的反向转化研究。展望未来，作者认为再生治疗的未来将依赖于发育生物学、干细胞科学、疾病建模、康复和临床转化的持续整合，以解决中枢神经系统疾病中未满足的医疗需求。
items.frontierRationale: 该文章发表于2026年，总结了iPSC技术在ALS药物发现中的最新应用，并强调了从基础研究到临床转化的整合趋势，具有明确的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: Sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a retrospective cross-sectional study.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder with substantial clinical heterogeneity. Systemic inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements have both been studied in ALS, but their sex-associated differences within ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized. To examine sex-associated differences in routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements in patients with ALS, and to determine whether these differences persisted after adjustment for available clinical and anthropometric variables. In this retrospective cross-sectional study, 135 patients with ALS were included. Routine inflammatory markers, including neutrophils, monocytes, lymphocytes, platelets, and erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR), were analyzed alongside quantitative neuromuscular ultrasound measurements. Between-sex comparisons were performed, and false discovery rate correction was applied to account for multiple testing. Multivariable linear regression analyses were performed with adjustment for age, disease duration, body mass index (BMI), ALSFRS-R total score, FVC% predicted, smoking status, hypertension, and diabetes. Female patients showed lower ALSFRS-R total scores and higher estimated progression rates in unadjusted comparisons, whereas pulmonary function variables did not differ significantly between sexes. After FDR correction, estimated progression rate, neutrophil count, monocyte count, ESR, and masseter muscle thickness remained significantly different between sexes, while the ALSFRS-R difference was borderline significant. In fully adjusted models, female sex was associated with lower neutrophil count, monocyte count, and median nerve cross-sectional area; biceps brachii thickness showed a less stable association after sensitivity analysis. An exploratory secondary analysis showed lower rectus femoris cross-sectional area during thigh-lift in female patients after full adjustment. In the spline sensitivity analysis, this association remained statistically significant but was interpreted cautiously because it was not present in the earlier adjustment models. Selected routine inflammatory markers and neuromuscular ultrasound measurements differed between male and female patients within this ALS cohort. These findings support consideration of sex and anthropometric context, including body size, when interpreting inflammatory markers and ultrasound-based structural measurements. In the absence of healthy controls, the observed ultrasound differences cannot be attributed specifically to ALS-related biology. Studies with healthy controls, longitudinal functional outcomes, body-composition assessment, and independent multicenter cohorts are needed to clarify the disease-specific and prognostic relevance of these observations.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中常规炎症标志物与神经肌肉超声测量的性别相关差异：一项回顾性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项回顾性研究分析了135例ALS患者的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声数据，发现女性患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数和ESR较低，咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积也较小，且这些差异在调整年龄、BMI等变量后仍存在。研究提示，在解读ALS患者的炎症指标和超声测量时，应考虑性别和体型因素。但该研究缺乏健康对照组，无法确定这些差异是否由ALS本身引起。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统评估了ALS队列中常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，提示性别和体型可能影响这些指标的解读，为未来ALS生物标志物研究和临床试验分层设计提供了重要参考。

aiRead.keyFinding: 女性ALS患者的中性粒细胞、单核细胞计数、ESR、咬肌厚度和正中神经横截面积显著低于男性，且部分差异在调整混杂因素后仍存在。
aiRead.limitation: 缺乏健康对照组，无法区分ALS特异性效应；单中心回顾性设计，样本量有限；超声测量的临床意义需进一步验证。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注包含健康对照和纵向随访的前瞻性研究，以及身体成分和预后关联的验证。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种具有显著临床异质性的进行性神经退行性疾病。系统性炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量均已在ALS中研究，但ALS队列中这些指标的性别相关差异尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在检查ALS患者常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量的性别差异，并确定这些差异在调整可用的临床和人体测量变量后是否持续存在。这项回顾性横断面研究纳入了135例ALS患者。分析了常规炎症标志物（包括中性粒细胞、单核细胞、淋巴细胞、血小板和红细胞沉降率）以及定量神经肌肉超声测量。进行了性别间比较，并应用错误发现率校正以处理多重检验。多变量线性回归分析调整了年龄、病程、体重指数、ALSFRS-R总分、FVC%预计值、吸烟状况、高血压和糖尿病。在未调整的比较中，女性患者的ALSFRS-R总分较低，估计进展率较高，而肺功能变量在性别间无显著差异。经FDR校正后，估计进展率、中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数、ESR和咬肌厚度在性别间仍显著不同，而ALSFRS-R差异为临界显著。在完全调整模型中，女性性别与较低的中性粒细胞计数、单核细胞计数和正中神经横截面积相关；肱二头肌厚度在敏感性分析中关联不稳定。探索性二次分析显示，完全调整后女性患者大腿抬高时股直肌横截面积较低。在样条敏感性分析中，该关联仍具有统计学显著性，但因未在早期调整模型中出现而被谨慎解读。在该ALS队列中，选定的常规炎症标志物和神经肌肉超声测量在男性和女性患者间存在差异。这些发现支持在解读炎症标志物和超声结构测量时考虑性别和人体测量背景（包括体型）。由于缺乏健康对照，观察到的超声差异不能特异性地归因于ALS相关生物学。需要包含健康对照、纵向功能结局、身体成分评估和独立多中心队列的研究来阐明这些观察的疾病特异性和预后相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦ALS中性别相关的炎症和超声差异，具有新近性和临床转化价值，有助于个体化评估和试验设计。

items.title: Pathology of general proprioception in a canine disease model of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Some forms of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) are associated with sequence variants in the superoxide dismutase 1 gene (SOD1). The mechanisms by which these variants contribute to ALS disease pathogenesis are poorly understood. Degenerative myelopathy (DM), a naturally occurring canine disease, shares similarities with some forms of SOD1-associated ALS, especially cases with sensory impairment. While motor pathway involvement in ALS has been extensively studied, sensory pathology has received comparatively less attention. To investigate whether pathology in the general proprioceptive pathway is associated with pelvic limb general proprioceptive ataxia, an early DM sign, we examined sensory system components of this pathway from Pembroke Welsh Corgis with early- and late-stage DM and age-matched controls. The disease was characterized by axonal pathology in the spinocerebellar tracts and the fasciculus gracilis, pronounced accumulation of SOD1-positive inclusions in nucleus thoracicus and dorsal root ganglia (DRG) neurons, and altered SOD1 immunolabeling in dorsal and ventral root axons and ensheathing myelin. Axonal pathology was also observed in a pelvic limb sensory nerve. These findings suggest that pathology in the proprioceptive sensory pathways may play a significant role in general proprioceptive ataxia in DM. Some dogs that were homozygous for the SOD1 risk allele did not develop clinical disease or the associated neuropathology, indicating that other factors in addition to the SOD1 mutation influence disease onset and progression.
items.titleZh: 犬肌萎缩侧索硬化疾病模型中一般本体感觉的病理学
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用犬类退行性脊髓病（DM）模型，发现本体感觉通路（包括脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核和背根神经节）存在显著的病理改变，如轴突变性和SOD1阳性包涵体积累，这些改变与早期共济失调症状相关。研究还发现，即使SOD1风险等位基因纯合，部分犬也未发病，提示其他因素参与疾病发生。
items.insight: 该研究填补了ALS感觉病理学研究的空白，提示本体感觉通路异常可能是ALS早期症状（如共济失调）的重要基础，为理解SOD1相关ALS的发病机制提供了新视角，并可能指导早期诊断和干预策略的开发。

aiRead.keyFinding: 犬DM模型中本体感觉通路（脊髓小脑束、薄束、胸核、DRG）出现轴突病理和SOD1包涵体积累，与早期共济失调相关。
aiRead.limitation: 犬DM模型与人类ALS存在差异，且部分SOD1纯合子犬未发病，提示遗传背景和环境因素影响，结果外推需谨慎。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续研究是否探索SOD1突变以外的影响因素，以及本体感觉病理在人类ALS患者中的验证。

items.abstractZh: 某些形式的肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1）的序列变异相关。这些变异导致ALS疾病发病的机制尚不清楚。退行性脊髓病（DM）是一种自然发生的犬类疾病，与某些形式的SOD1相关ALS（尤其是伴有感觉障碍的病例）具有相似性。虽然ALS中运动通路的受累已被广泛研究，但感觉病理学受到的关注相对较少。为了研究一般本体感觉通路中的病理是否与骨盆肢体一般本体感觉性共济失调（DM的早期体征）相关，我们检查了来自彭布罗克威尔士柯基犬（早期和晚期DM）及年龄匹配对照的该通路的感觉系统组成部分。该疾病的特征包括脊髓小脑束和薄束中的轴突病理、胸核和背根神经节（DRG）神经元中SOD1阳性包涵体的显著积累，以及背根和腹根轴突及其髓鞘中SOD1免疫标记的改变。在骨盆肢体感觉神经中也观察到轴突病理。这些发现表明，本体感觉通路中的病理可能在DM的一般本体感觉性共济失调中发挥重要作用。一些SOD1风险等位基因纯合子的犬并未发展出临床疾病或相关的神经病理，表明除SOD1突变外，其他因素也影响疾病的发病和进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于ALS中常被忽视的感觉通路病理，利用自然发生的犬类模型，具有直接的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Tofersen Treatment in SOD1 -ALS: Real-World Evidence from a Retrospective Multicenter Study in France (FORSLA Study).
items.summary: To evaluate the effectiveness of Tofersen in patients with superoxide dismutase 1 gene ( SOD1-ALS ) patients in France in a real-world setting, using disease progression within patient comparisons and with a historical cohort. Patients with SOD1 -ALS were included from across 19 French FILSLAN network centers. Baseline was defined as the treatment initiation date. Main endpoints were the ALSFRS-R progression rate and plasmatic neurofilament light chain (NfL) levels at baseline and 12 months after baseline. In the Tofersen Cohort (N=46), within-group comparisons showed that the mean ALS functional rating scale revised (ALSFRS-R) progression rate slowed from 0.53 ± 0.5 at baseline to 0.22 ± 0.3 point/month at 12 months ( P =.006). NfL levels significantly decreased from 89.0 ± 9.0 pg/ml at baseline to 29.2 ± 19.5.5 at 12 months ( P =.004). Exploratory comparisons with a propensity score (PS) matched historical cohort (39 matched pairs) using a mixed-effects model, ALSFRS-R progression rate at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months after baseline, showed no statistically significant differences between groups P =.30, whereas longitudinal ALSFRS-R scores differed significantly between groups (time-treatment interaction P =.006). The mean survival of the PS matched population was longer in the Tofersen Cohort (42.6 months) than the Historical Cohort (31.8 months) P =.004. Time-dependent adjusted cox analysis showed that Tofersen was associated with a reduction in mortality risk (adjusted HR=0.34; 95% CI, 0.12-0.91; P =.03). Tofersen seems to be associated with slower functional decline and reduced NfL levels. While limitations of retrospective design and ALSFRS-R sensitivity must be acknowledged, these findings provide real-world evidence suggesting a clinical benefit of Tofersen.

items.titleZh: Tofersen治疗SOD1-ALS：法国多中心回顾性研究的真实世界证据（FORSLA研究）
items.summaryZh: 法国19个中心46例SOD1-ALS患者的真实世界数据显示，接受Tofersen治疗12个月后，功能衰退速度（ALSFRS-R进展率）较基线减缓约58%，血浆NfL水平下降约67%。与历史对照相比，Tofersen组中位生存期延长约11个月，死亡风险降低66%。研究为观察性证据，存在回顾性设计固有局限。
items.insight: 这是SOD1-ALS靶向治疗领域规模较大的真实世界研究之一，在随机对照试验（VALOR）之后提供了更贴近临床实践的疗效和生存数据，对评估Tofersen在法国真实人群中的转化价值具有直接参考意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: Tofersen治疗12个月显著减缓ALSFRS-R进展率（0.53→0.22点/月，P=0.006）并降低NfL水平（89.0→29.2 pg/ml，P=0.004）；与历史对照相比，死亡风险降低66%（HR=0.34，P=0.03）。
aiRead.limitation: 回顾性设计、样本量较小（N=46）、ALSFRS-R对功能变化敏感性有限、历史对照可能存在未测量的混杂因素。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注Tofersen长期（>12个月）疗效维持情况、早期治疗（症状前或病程极早期）的获益证据，以及真实世界NfL动态变化与长期预后的关联。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估Tofersen在法国真实世界环境中对超氧化物歧化酶1基因（SOD1-ALS）患者的疗效，采用患者内疾病进展比较及与历史队列的比较方法。研究纳入来自法国19个FILSLAN网络中心的SOD1-ALS患者。基线定义为治疗开始日期。主要终点为基线和基线后12个月的ALSFRS-R进展率和血浆神经丝轻链（NfL）水平。在Tofersen队列（N=46）中，组内比较显示，平均ALS功能评定量表修订版（ALSFRS-R）进展率从基线的0.53±0.5点/月减缓至12个月时的0.22±0.3点/月（P=0.006）。NfL水平从基线的89.0±9.0 pg/ml显著下降至12个月时的29.2±19.5 pg/ml（P=0.004）。与倾向评分（PS）匹配的历史队列（39对匹配）的探索性比较（使用混合效应模型）显示，基线、6个月和12个月后的ALSFRS-R进展率组间无统计学显著差异（P=0.30），而纵向ALSFRS-R评分组间差异显著（时间-治疗交互作用P=0.006）。PS匹配人群的平均生存期在Tofersen队列（42.6个月）长于历史队列（31.8个月）（P=0.004）。时间依赖性校正Cox分析显示，Tofersen与死亡风险降低相关（校正HR=0.34；95% CI，0.12-0.91；P=0.03）。Tofersen似乎与较慢的功能衰退和NfL水平降低相关。虽然必须承认回顾性设计和ALSFRS-R敏感性的局限性，但这些发现提供了提示Tofersen临床获益的真实世界证据。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，提供了Tofersen在真实世界SOD1-ALS患者中延缓功能衰退和延长生存的最新证据，具有明确的ALS转化价值。

items.title: Gut microbiota and brain health: Disease-specific pathways and emerging therapeutic strategies.
items.summary: The microbiota-gut-brain axis (MGBA) has emerged as a dynamic, bidirectional communication system linking the gastrointestinal tract and the central nervous system (CNS) through neural, immune, endocrine, and metabolic mechanisms. Increasing evidence indicates that alterations in gut microbial communities are associated with a wide range of neurological disorders; however, the strength of this association varies across diseases, and many mechanistic observations still rely predominantly on experimental models rather than human studies. This review provides an overview of current evidence regarding the role of the gut microbiota in maintaining CNS homeostasis, with particular emphasis on intestinal barrier function, immune modulation, vagal and enteric communication, and the generation of biologically active microbial metabolites, including short-chain fatty acids, bile acids, and neurotransmitter-related compounds. Studies in both clinical and experimental settings have reported disease-specific microbial signatures in conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, multiple sclerosis, autism spectrum disorders, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In parallel, microbiota-directed interventions-including probiotics, prebiotics, dietary approaches, fecal microbiota transplantation, and strategies targeting microbial metabolites-have produced encouraging findings in preclinical studies and early-stage clinical investigations. Nevertheless, considerable heterogeneity in study populations, experimental methodologies, and therapeutic protocols continues to limit the translation of these findings into routine clinical practice. Collectively, current evidence supports the MGBA as a valuable framework for understanding neurological diseases while underscoring the need for rigorously designed longitudinal studies and well-controlled clinical trials to define its therapeutic relevance better.

items.titleZh: 肠道微生物群与大脑健康：疾病特异性通路与新兴治疗策略
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了肠道微生物群与大脑健康之间联系的最新证据，指出微生物-肠-脑轴通过多种机制影响中枢神经系统。文章提到，在ALS等多种神经退行性疾病中观察到特定的肠道微生物特征，但多数机制证据来自动物模型。针对微生物群的干预（如益生菌、饮食调整、粪菌移植）在早期研究中显示出潜力，但尚未达到临床应用阶段。

items.abstractZh: 微生物-肠-脑轴（MGBA）已成为一个动态的双向通讯系统，通过神经、免疫、内分泌和代谢机制连接胃肠道与中枢神经系统（CNS）。越来越多的证据表明，肠道微生物群落的改变与多种神经系统疾病相关；然而，这种关联的强度因疾病而异，许多机制观察仍主要依赖于实验模型而非人类研究。本综述概述了关于肠道微生物群在维持CNS稳态中作用的现有证据，特别强调肠道屏障功能、免疫调节、迷走神经和肠神经通讯，以及生物活性微生物代谢产物（包括短链脂肪酸、胆汁酸和神经递质相关化合物）的产生。临床和实验研究均报告了在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、多发性硬化症、自闭症谱系障碍和肌萎缩侧索硬化等疾病中的疾病特异性微生物特征。与此同时，针对微生物群的干预措施——包括益生菌、益生元、饮食方法、粪便微生物群移植以及针对微生物代谢产物的策略——在临床前研究和早期临床研究中产生了令人鼓舞的结果。然而，研究人群、实验方法和治疗方案方面的显著异质性继续限制着这些发现向常规临床实践的转化。总的来说，现有证据支持MGBA作为理解神经系统疾病的有价值框架，同时强调需要严格设计的纵向研究和良好对照的临床试验，以更好地确定其治疗相关性。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述发表于2026年，整合了最新的MGBA研究，并明确将ALS列为相关疾病，突出了微生物靶向干预的转化价值。

items.title: The Anterior Belly of the Digastric Muscle as a Novel Target for Needle Electromyography in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis.
items.summary: Needle electromyography (EMG) in the bulbar region aids in the diagnosis of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) but remains technically challenging. The genioglossus muscle (GM) is commonly examined; however, pain and poor relaxation may limit its evaluation. The trapezius is an alternative target but is innervated by the spinal accessory nerve. We investigated the utility of the anterior belly of the digastric muscle (ABDM), innervated by the trigeminal nerve, for bulbar EMG evaluation. In this unblinded, prospective observational study, consecutive patients with suspected ALS underwent needle EMG of the ABDM, GM, masseter muscle (MM), and trapezius. Relaxation levels, EMG abnormalities, and pain (100-mm visual analog scale [VAS]) were assessed. Twenty-seven clinically diagnosed ALS patients were analyzed. Relaxation was better in the ABDM than in the GM (p < 0.001) and comparable to that in the MM and trapezius. Fasciculation potentials were detected more often in the ABDM (52%) than in the GM (0%) and MM (22%; p = 0.039) and were comparable to the trapezius (59%). Chronic denervation occurred at similar frequencies across muscles (33%-59%). The combination of abnormal spontaneous activity and chronic denervation was most frequent in the ABDM (37%). Pain was lower with the ABDM (median VAS score of 21) than with the GM (28; p = 0.0052) and MM (32; p < 0.001) and was similar to the trapezius (23). The ABDM may be a practical additional target for bulbar EMG in ALS, with favorable relaxation, lower pain, and potentially improved electrodiagnostic yield.
items.titleZh: 二腹肌前腹作为肌萎缩侧索硬化症针极肌电图检查的新靶点
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了二腹肌前腹（ABDM）作为ALS球部肌电图检查新靶点的可行性。结果显示，与传统的颏舌肌相比，ABDM在患者放松程度和疼痛控制方面表现更优，且束颤电位的检出率更高（52% vs 0%），与斜方肌相当。ABDM可能提高球部EMG的诊断效率，为ALS的神经电生理评估提供更舒适、更有效的选择。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS球部肌电图检查提供了一个新的、更易操作且患者耐受性更好的靶点，可能改善早期诊断的敏感性和患者体验，值得关注其在临床实践中的推广潜力。

aiRead.keyFinding: 二腹肌前腹在ALS患者中表现出更好的放松程度、更低的疼痛和更高的束颤电位检出率，可能作为球部EMG的实用附加靶点。
aiRead.limitation: 研究为非盲设计，样本量较小（27例），且未与金标准（如尸检或长期随访）进行对照，结果需进一步验证。

items.abstractZh: 球部区域的针极肌电图（EMG）有助于肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）的诊断，但在技术上仍具挑战性。颏舌肌（GM）是常用检查部位，但疼痛和放松不良可能限制其评估。斜方肌是替代靶点，但由副神经支配。我们研究了由三叉神经支配的二腹肌前腹（ABDM）在球部EMG评估中的效用。在这项非盲、前瞻性观察性研究中，连续疑似ALS患者接受了ABDM、GM、咬肌（MM）和斜方肌的针极EMG检查。评估了放松程度、EMG异常和疼痛（100毫米视觉模拟量表[VAS]）。分析了27例临床确诊的ALS患者。ABDM的放松程度优于GM（p < 0.001），与MM和斜方肌相当。ABDM中检测到束颤电位的频率（52%）高于GM（0%）和MM（22%；p = 0.039），与斜方肌（59%）相当。慢性失神经在各肌肉中的发生频率相似（33%-59%）。异常自发电活动与慢性失神经的组合在ABDM中最常见（37%）。ABDM的疼痛评分（中位VAS 21）低于GM（28；p = 0.0052）和MM（32；p < 0.001），与斜方肌（23）相似。ABDM可能作为ALS球部EMG的实用附加靶点，具有较好的放松程度、较低的疼痛和潜在更高的电诊断阳性率。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究提出了一种新的球部EMG靶点，具有近期临床转化价值，可能优化ALS的诊断流程。

items.title: Macrophage responses to and elevated antibody levels against Chlorovirus ATCV-1 in ALS patients.
items.summary: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1) is a giant virus that is part of the human oral microvirome. Previously we showed that ATCV-1 infects mouse macrophages, stimulates production of inflammatory cytokines, and accelerates motor neuron disease in the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) model SOD1-G93A transgenic mice. This, coupled with significantly elevated levels of serum IgG1 antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls, suggests involvement of ATCV-1 in ALS. Herein, using serum and CSF from a different ALS cohort we again show elevated antibodies to ATCV-1 in ALS patients compared with healthy controls. To assess ATCV-1 in human macrophages, we challenged immature (IMM), M0, M1, and M2 human THP-1 macrophage cells containing an Interferon Stimulated Response Element (ISRE) promoter-reporter with ATCV-1 or its Major Capsid protein (MCP) glycans. ATCV-1 infected M1 THP-1 to a greater degree than IMM, M0, or M2 THP-1. The initial high ISRE-promoter activity of M1 THP-1 was suppressed by the MCP-Glycans of ATCV-1. M0, but not IMM or M2 THP-1 produced IL-6 in response to ATCV-1 or its MCP-glycan, while high levels of IL-6 from unchallenged M1 THP-1 increased further by ATCV-1 or its MCP glycan. In contrast, ATCV-1 or its MCP-Glycan significantly reduced the high levels of IL-10 produced by M2 THP-1. Thus, antibody to ATCV-1 in ALS patients and the susceptibility of human M1 macrophages to ATCV-1 infection with boosted inflammatory cytokine and diminished anti-inflammatory cytokine production suggest that ATCV-1 may contribute to ALS motor neuron disease.

items.titleZh: ALS患者中巨噬细胞对Chlorovirus ATCV-1的反应及抗体水平升高
items.summaryZh: 这项研究在独立ALS患者队列中再次证实了抗ATCV-1（一种口腔巨型病毒）抗体水平升高。体外实验显示，该病毒优先感染促炎型M1巨噬细胞，增强IL-6等炎症因子产生，同时抑制M2巨噬细胞的抗炎因子IL-10。结果支持ATCV-1可能通过加剧神经炎症参与ALS发病的假说。
items.insight: 该研究为环境病毒（ATCV-1）参与ALS发病提供了新的独立队列证据，并首次在人巨噬细胞亚型中揭示了病毒偏向性感染和炎症失衡机制，对理解ALS的炎症病理和潜在环境触发因素具有跟踪价值。

items.abstractZh: Acanthocystis turfacea chlorella virus 1 (ATCV-1)是一种巨型病毒，属于人类口腔微生物组的一部分。此前研究显示，ATCV-1可感染小鼠巨噬细胞，刺激炎症细胞因子产生，并加速肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）模型SOD1-G93A转基因小鼠的运动神经元疾病进展。结合ALS患者血清中抗ATCV-1的IgG1抗体水平显著高于健康对照，提示ATCV-1可能参与ALS发病。本研究使用来自不同ALS队列的血清和脑脊液，再次证实ALS患者中抗ATCV-1抗体水平高于健康对照。为评估ATCV-1对人巨噬细胞的作用，研究者使用含有干扰素刺激反应元件（ISRE）启动子报告基因的未成熟（IMM）、M0、M1和M2人THP-1巨噬细胞，分别以ATCV-1或其主要衣壳蛋白（MCP）聚糖进行刺激。结果显示，ATCV-1对M1 THP-1的感染程度高于IMM、M0或M2 THP-1。M1 THP-1初始较高的ISRE启动子活性被ATCV-1的MCP聚糖抑制。M0（而非IMM或M2）THP-1在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖刺激下产生IL-6，而未受刺激的M1 THP-1本身产生的高水平IL-6在ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖作用下进一步升高。相反，ATCV-1或其MCP聚糖显著降低了M2 THP-1产生的高水平IL-10。因此，ALS患者中抗ATCV-1抗体以及人M1巨噬细胞对ATCV-1感染的易感性（伴随炎症细胞因子增强和抗炎细胞因子减少）提示ATCV-1可能促进ALS运动神经元疾病进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，提供了独立队列中ALS患者抗ATCV-1抗体升高的新证据，并首次阐明该病毒对人M1巨噬细胞的偏向性感染及炎症调节机制，具有直接的ALS病因相关性。

items.title: Impact of Sexuality in Patients With Motor Neuron Disease.
items.summary: Sexuality is a relevant yet understudied aspect in people living with motor neuron disease (MND). This study aimed to assess whether sexuality in people with MND is influenced by motor, cognitive, behavioral, or mood disturbances, and to explore whether being sexually active impacts caregiver burden. We conducted a cross-sectional observational study involving participants with MND and their primary caregivers from three ALS multidisciplinary units in Seville, Spain. Data were collected between October 2018 and July 2021. Functional, cognitive, behavioral, and mood assessments were conducted. Sexuality was evaluated through sex-specific questionnaires. Caregiver burden was assessed using the Zarit Burden Interview. Among 66 participants who completed the sexuality assessment, 42.9% reported sexual activity in the previous month. Of these, 70% had no sexual dysfunction, while 26.7% had moderate and 3.3% severe dysfunction. No correlation was found between sexual activity and motor function. Sexual activity was less frequent in participants with apathy (p = 0.026), depression (p = 0.021), and frontotemporal dementia (p = 0.013). Among sexually active patients, those with cognitive impairment-particularly memory dysfunction-had higher rates of orgasm difficulties (p = 0.019). No other clinical parameters were related to sexuality. Sexuality of participants with MND did not influence caregiver burden. Sexuality in MND is more associated with cognitive and mood factors than with motor disability. Addressing sexuality in clinical practice may contribute to improving quality of life and should be integrated into the multidisciplinary care of MND patients.
items.titleZh: 运动神经元病患者性功能的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项来自西班牙的横断面研究调查了66名MND患者的性功能，发现约43%的患者在近一个月内有性活动，其中多数无性功能障碍。性活动与运动功能无关，但与情感淡漠、抑郁和额颞叶痴呆显著相关，且认知障碍（特别是记忆问题）与性高潮困难相关。性功能不影响照护者负担。研究提示，性功能问题在MND中更多与认知和情绪因素相关，临床应关注这一方面。
items.insight: 这项研究填补了ALS/MND领域性功能研究的空白，提示性功能问题与认知和情绪因素相关而非运动功能，为多学科护理中纳入性健康咨询提供了依据，值得ALS研究者关注以改善患者生活质量。

aiRead.keyFinding: MND患者的性功能与认知和情绪因素（如情感淡漠、抑郁、额颞叶痴呆）相关，而非运动功能；性功能不影响照护者负担。

aiRead.watchNext: 未来研究应探索针对认知和情绪干预对性功能的影响，以及性健康咨询在MND多学科护理中的实际效果。

items.abstractZh: 性功能是运动神经元病（MND）患者中一个相关但研究不足的方面。本研究旨在评估MND患者的性功能是否受运动、认知、行为或情绪障碍的影响，并探讨性活跃是否影响照护者负担。我们进行了一项横断面观察性研究，涉及来自西班牙塞维利亚三个ALS多学科单元的MND患者及其主要照护者。数据收集于2018年10月至2021年7月。进行了功能、认知、行为和情绪评估。性功能通过性别特异性问卷进行评估。照护者负担使用Zarit负担访谈进行评估。在完成性功能评估的66名参与者中，42.9%报告在过去一个月内有性活动。其中，70%无性功能障碍，26.7%有中度功能障碍，3.3%有严重功能障碍。未发现性活动与运动功能之间的相关性。性活动在伴有情感淡漠（p = 0.026）、抑郁（p = 0.021）和额颞叶痴呆（p = 0.013）的参与者中较少见。在性活跃患者中，伴有认知障碍（尤其是记忆功能障碍）的患者出现性高潮困难的比例更高（p = 0.019）。其他临床参数与性功能无关。MND参与者的性功能不影响照护者负担。MND中的性功能更多与认知和情绪因素相关，而非运动残疾。在临床实践中处理性问题可能有助于改善生活质量，并应纳入MND患者的多学科护理中。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦ALS患者常被忽视的性功能问题，揭示了认知和情绪因素的关键作用，具有直接的临床转化价值。

items.title: Association of Military Branch and Rank With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Incidence Among United States Veterans.
items.summary: Military service is one of the most consistent risk factors for the development of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but little is known about what aspects of military service matter. Understanding the distribution of ALS risk in military personnel may help identify key risk factors. We aimed to ascertain the association of United States (US) military branch and rank with incident ALS. We conducted a longitudinal cohort study including all veterans with a Veterans Health Administration encounter from January 1, 2000, through October 1, 2024, and more than 2 years of follow-up. Incident ALS was identified through medical records. Exposures included military branch (Army, Navy, Air Force, Marine Corps, Coast Guard, or multiple branches), military rank (officer, enlisted, or both), and length of service. Risk was estimated with Cox proportional hazards models, controlled for age, adjusted for race/ethnicity, and stratified by sex. The analytic sample comprised 9,157,938 men (13,935 incident ALS cases, mean age = 56.9 years) and 784,941 women (484 cases, mean age = 42.4 at start of follow up). Among men, compared with service in the Army, service in the Air Force (hazard ratio [HR] = 1.29, 95% CI 1.23-1.35), Navy (HR = 1.15, 95% CI 1.10-1.20), and Coast Guard (HR = 1.26, 95% CI 1.06-1.50) was associated with higher rates of ALS and service in the Marines a lower rate (HR = 0.78, 95% CI 0.68-0.88). Officers had higher rates than enlisted personnel (men, HR = 1.64, 95% CI 1.53-1.74; women, HR = 1.72, 95% CI 1.31-2.27). Longer service was associated with lower rates of ALS. In age-stratified models, differences in hazard rates between Army veterans and Air Force, Navy, and Coast Guard veterans were greatest for the youngest men (17-61 years, HR range = 1.26 to 1.51) and smallest for the oldest (>75-104 years, HR range = 0.99 to 1.12). ALS rates varied considerably by branch and rank in the US military, with larger differences among younger veterans. Officers and those serving in the Air Force, Navy, or Coast Guard may incur exposure to military environments that increase risk of ALS. It is imperative to identify relevant exposures to reduce harm to service members and, potentially, civilians with similar exposures.
items.titleZh: 美国退伍军人中军种和军衔与肌萎缩侧索硬化发病率的关联
items.summaryZh: 这项大型队列研究分析了美国退伍军人中军种、军衔与ALS发病率的关系。研究发现，空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役者ALS风险高于陆军，而海军陆战队风险较低；军官风险高于士兵；服役年限越长风险越低。这些差异在年轻退伍军人中更为明显。研究提示特定军事环境暴露可能增加ALS风险，但具体暴露因素尚待识别。
items.insight: 这项研究是迄今规模最大的关于军事服役细节与ALS风险的队列研究之一，覆盖近千万退伍军人，首次系统揭示军种和军衔对ALS风险的影响，为识别可干预的军事环境暴露因素提供了关键线索，对ALS病因研究和军人健康防护具有重要指导意义。

aiRead.keyFinding: 空军、海军和海岸警卫队服役及军官身份与ALS风险升高相关，而海军陆战队和较长服役年限与风险降低相关，且年轻退伍军人中差异更显著。
aiRead.limitation: 观察性设计无法确定因果关系；未测量具体环境暴露；依赖医疗记录可能漏诊；退伍军人健康管理局人群可能不代表所有退伍军人。

items.abstractZh: 军事服役是肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）发生最一致的风险因素之一，但关于军事服役的哪些方面重要知之甚少。了解军人中ALS风险的分布可能有助于识别关键风险因素。我们旨在确定美国军种和军衔与偶发ALS的关联。我们进行了一项纵向队列研究，纳入2000年1月1日至2024年10月1日期间所有在退伍军人健康管理局有就诊记录且随访超过2年的退伍军人。偶发ALS通过医疗记录识别。暴露因素包括军种（陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或多个军种）、军衔（军官、士兵或两者）以及服役年限。风险使用Cox比例风险模型估计，控制年龄，调整种族/民族，并按性别分层。分析样本包括9,157,938名男性（13,935例偶发ALS病例，平均年龄56.9岁）和784,941名女性（484例病例，随访开始时平均年龄42.4岁）。在男性中，与陆军服役相比，空军（风险比[HR]=1.29，95% CI 1.23-1.35）、海军（HR=1.15，95% CI 1.10-1.20）和海岸警卫队（HR=1.26，95% CI 1.06-1.50）服役与更高的ALS发病率相关，而海军陆战队服役与较低发病率相关（HR=0.78，95% CI 0.68-0.88）。军官的发病率高于士兵（男性，HR=1.64，95% CI 1.53-1.74；女性，HR=1.72，95% CI 1.31-2.27）。较长的服役年限与较低的ALS发病率相关。在年龄分层模型中，陆军退伍军人与空军、海军和海岸警卫队退伍军人之间的风险差异在年轻男性中最大（17-61岁，HR范围=1.26至1.51），在老年男性中最小（>75-104岁，HR范围=0.99至1.12）。美国军队中ALS发病率因军种和军衔而有显著差异，年轻退伍军人中差异更大。军官以及在空军、海军或海岸警卫队服役的人员可能暴露于增加ALS风险的军事环境。识别相关暴露以减少对服役人员以及可能具有类似暴露的平民的伤害至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2000-2024年近千万退伍军人的最新纵向数据，首次明确军种和军衔与ALS风险的关联，具有高度ALS病因学相关性。

items.title: Exosomal miRNA in cerebrospinal fluid as biomarkers for neurodegenerative disease.
items.summary: Cerebrospinal fluid protein biomarkers, such as the Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio, phosphorylated tau, and neurofilament light chain, have significantly advanced the diagnostic process for Alzheimer's disease. Nonetheless, these biomarkers face challenges in effectively distinguishing Alzheimer's disease from frontotemporal dementia or Parkinson's disease from dementia with Lewy bodies. This limitation arises from overlapping protein profiles and the variability inherent in immunoassay techniques. A complementary class of analytes is exosomal microRNAs in cerebrospinal fluid, where these non-coding RNAs are secreted by neurons, astrocytes, and microglia, are resistant to RNase degradation, and have a disease-specific expression pattern. This review critically evaluates the existing evidence of cerebrospinal fluid exosomal miRNAs as diagnostic biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia, Parkinson's disease, dementia with Lewy bodies, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Exosome isolation techniques and detection platform characteristics were compared using RT-qPCR, droplet digital PCR, and small RNA sequencing. Pre-analytical factors, such as collection protocols, hemolysis contamination, freeze-thaw cycling, and circadian sampling variation, were assessed. miRNA profiling data based on disease stratification, receiver operating characteristic performance of the combinatorial panel, and strategies combining exosomal miRNAs with core cerebrospinal fluid proteins were synthesized. This article brings together disease-specific miRNA signatures, pre-analytical standardization needs, and diagnostic accuracy analyses in a translational model to fill the literature gap and form the basis for developing exosomal miRNA panels for rigorously validated clinical laboratory practice.

items.summaryZh: 这篇综述总结了脑脊液外泌体 miRNA 作为神经退行性疾病（包括 ALS）诊断生物标志物的潜力。外泌体 miRNA 具有疾病特异性表达模式，且对 RNase 降解有抗性，可能弥补传统蛋白标志物在区分重叠疾病表型上的不足。文章还讨论了外泌体分离和检测技术（如 RT-qPCR、ddPCR、小 RNA 测序）的优缺点，以及预分析因素（如采集、溶血、冻融、昼夜节律）对结果的影响。

items.abstractZh: 脑脊液蛋白生物标志物，如 Aβ42/Aβ40 比值、磷酸化 tau 和神经丝轻链，已显著推进阿尔茨海默病的诊断进程。然而，这些生物标志物在有效区分阿尔茨海默病与额颞叶痴呆，或帕金森病与路易体痴呆方面面临挑战。这一局限性源于重叠的蛋白谱和免疫测定技术固有的变异性。一类互补的分析物是脑脊液中的外泌体 microRNA，这些非编码 RNA 由神经元、星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞分泌，对 RNase 降解具有抗性，并具有疾病特异性表达模式。本综述批判性评估了脑脊液外泌体 miRNA 作为阿尔茨海默病、额颞叶痴呆、帕金森病、路易体痴呆和肌萎缩侧索硬化症诊断生物标志物的现有证据。使用 RT-qPCR、微滴数字 PCR 和小 RNA 测序比较了外泌体分离技术和检测平台特性。评估了预分析因素，如采集方案、溶血污染、冻融循环和昼夜采样变异。综合了基于疾病分层的 miRNA 谱数据、组合 panel 的受试者工作特征性能，以及外泌体 miRNA 与核心脑脊液蛋白联合的策略。本文汇集了疾病特异性 miRNA 特征、预分析标准化需求和诊断准确性分析，形成转化模型，以填补文献空白，并为开发经严格验证的临床实验室实践中外泌体 miRNA panel 奠定基础。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述整合了最新（2026年）的脑脊液外泌体 miRNA 研究，聚焦于解决神经退行性疾病鉴别诊断难题，具有直接的转化价值。

items.title: Poor Prognostic Factors After Gastrostomy in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Two-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) is widely used to manage dysphagia in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, some patients experience rapid clinical deterioration following the procedure. Prognostic factors specific to outcomes following PEG remain insufficiently defined. This two-center retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with ALS who underwent PEG prior to tracheostomy between April 2011 and June 2023. Cox proportional hazards modeling was used to identify independent prognostic factors following PEG. Explanatory variables included age, sex, onset site, percent of normal forced vital capacity (%FVC), disease duration from onset to PEG, and body mass index. Optimal cutoff values for continuous variables were determined using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic analyses. Among six examined clinical variables, four were independently associated with worse outcomes after PEG placement as follows: male sex, spinal onset, lower %FVC at the time of PEG, and shorter duration from onset to PEG. Cutoff values were determined as %FVC < 63% and disease duration < 12 months. Log-rank analyses confirmed significantly shorter post-PEG survival in patients meeting these criteria. Poorer respiratory function and shorter duration from disease onset to PEG were strongly associated with worse prognosis after PEG. Male sex emerged as an independent prognostic factor, suggesting potential biological differences in disease progression after gastrostomy. These findings underscore the importance of comprehensive clinical evaluation when considering PEG in patients with ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者胃造口术后不良预后因素：一项双中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项双中心回顾性研究分析了117例ALS患者，发现PEG术后预后不良的独立预测因素包括：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时%FVC低于63%、从起病到PEG时间短于12个月。符合这些标准的患者术后生存期显著缩短。研究提示，在决定是否进行PEG时，应综合评估呼吸功能和疾病病程，而非仅考虑吞咽困难。

items.abstractZh: 经皮内镜下胃造口术（PEG）广泛用于管理肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的吞咽困难。然而，部分患者在术后出现快速临床恶化。PEG术后结局相关的预后因素尚未充分明确。这项双中心回顾性队列研究纳入了2011年4月至2023年6月期间在气管切开前接受PEG的117例ALS患者。采用Cox比例风险模型识别PEG术后的独立预后因素。解释变量包括年龄、性别、起病部位、用力肺活量占预计值百分比（%FVC）、从起病到PEG的病程以及体重指数。连续变量的最佳截断值通过时间依赖性受试者工作特征分析确定。在检查的六个临床变量中，四个与PEG术后较差结局独立相关：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时较低的%FVC以及从起病到PEG的较短病程。截断值确定为%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月。Log-rank分析证实，符合这些标准的患者PEG术后生存期显著缩短。较差的呼吸功能和从起病到PEG的较短病程与PEG术后较差预后密切相关。男性作为独立预后因素出现，提示胃造口术后疾病进展可能存在生物学差异。这些发现强调了在考虑对ALS患者进行PEG时进行全面临床评估的重要性。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过系统性文献回顾和生物信息学分析，筛选出15个与ALS相关的环状RNA（circRNA）候选分子。研究发现这些circRNA参与调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等ALS相关通路，并能海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。特别值得注意的是，ALS相关的FUS基因突变会改变FUS蛋白与circRNA的结合能力。患者组织RNA-seq数据也证实了相关基因表达的改变。该研究提示circRNA可能在ALS发病机制中扮演重要角色。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾，确定了与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20种RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异体显著改变其与环状RNA的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受影响的中枢神经系统组织中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因和枢纽蛋白的表达发生显著改变。总之，我们的研究结果表明circRNAs是ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。

items.title: Identifying candidate therapeutic targets in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through a transcriptome-wide machine-learning consensus approach for drug repurposing.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease for which effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. This study aimed to derive internally recurrent ALS-associated transcriptional signatures and generate directionally interpretable drug-repositioning hypotheses using a consensus machine-learning framework. Two publicly available transcriptomic datasets from motor cortex (E-MTAB-2325) and blood (E-TABM-940) were analyzed using four feature-selection methods within 100 repetitions of 4-fold cross-validation. Probes recurrently selected in models achieving an accuracy of at least 0.90 were prioritized and examined using COGENA pathway enrichment and Connectivity Map drug-signature analysis. Fifteen qualifying models were obtained for the motor-cortex dataset and 55 for the blood dataset. No exact prioritized gene or probe identifier was shared between the two top-100 signatures, but pathway-level integration identified complementary evidence involving glial and immune regulation, proteostasis and vesicle trafficking, MAPK-related stress signaling, cytoskeletal and extracellular remodeling, and RNA-related processes. The motor-cortex dataset additionally emphasized astroglial support, glutamate handling, and inclusion-body regulation, whereas the blood dataset highlighted cytokine regulation and directionally heterogeneous immune, mitochondrial, and metabolic signals. Deferoxamine and disulfiram showed the clearest reversal-compatible profiles in motor cortex, whereas yohimbic acid and atovaquone showed reversal-compatible profiles in blood. Ciprofloxacin, prochlorperazine, and a compound group led by androsterone instead showed concordant connectivity. The results provide transparent, hypothesis-generating gene, pathway, and compound priorities, but they do not establish biomarkers, therapeutic efficacy, or clinical suitability and require validation in independent cohorts and experimental ALS models.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法仍然有限。本研究旨在利用共识机器学习框架，推导内部复现的ALS相关转录特征，并生成方向可解释的药物重定位假设。研究分析了来自运动皮层（E-MTAB-2325）和血液（E-TABM-940）的两个公开转录组数据集，使用四种特征选择方法，在100次4折交叉验证中重复进行。优先考虑在准确率至少达到0.90的模型中反复选择的探针，并使用COGENA通路富集和Connectivity Map药物特征分析进行检验。运动皮层数据集获得15个合格模型，血液数据集获得55个。两个前100特征签名之间没有共享的精确优先基因或探针标识符，但通路水平整合确定了涉及胶质细胞和免疫调节、蛋白稳态和囊泡运输、MAPK相关应激信号、细胞骨架和细胞外重塑以及RNA相关过程的互补证据。运动皮层数据集额外强调了星形胶质细胞支持、谷氨酸处理和包涵体调节，而血液数据集则突出了细胞因子调节以及方向异质性的免疫、线粒体和代谢信号。在运动皮层中，去铁胺和双硫仑显示出最明显的逆转兼容特征，而在血液中，育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌显示出逆转兼容特征。环丙沙星、丙氯拉嗪以及以雄酮为首的化合物组则显示出一致的连接性。结果提供了透明的、假设生成的基因、通路和化合物优先级，但并未确立生物标志物、治疗效果或临床适用性，需要在独立队列和实验性ALS模型中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究结合了最新的机器学习共识方法和公开转录组数据，为ALS药物再利用提供了新近的、转化导向的候选靶点列表。
